queries: site.arxiv.org 2024 March large language models generalization reasoning GSM Plus

sources_considered.why: Confirms the original February 2024 version and its evaluation scope.
Primary evaluation reports both robustness failures and successful transfer on particular question variations.
Earlier successful planning research is material context, outside the target quarter.
Its March 2024 publication date should not turn experiments already public in 2023 into new target-period evidence.

evidence_items.locator: Section 1, Introduction, summary of experimental findings
evidence_items.explanation: The study evaluates 25 LLMs and four prompting techniques. It reports resilience to some numerical and wording changes alongside substantial failures under other mathematical perturbations, supporting the contextual claim of partial but unreliable generalization.

GPT-4 generated planning programs that generalized to other tasks with automated debugging support. This challenges any blanket dismissal of planning generalization, but predates the target quarter and does not establish broad reliability.

unresolved_gaps: No universal threshold for enough generalization is supplied.
The target-period evidence is strongest for mathematical reasoning, not every AI application.
The GSM-Plus report dates the public findings but does not disclose exact execution dates for every experiment.
